title: Regional Distribution of Hydrogen Deployment in China
intro: Hydrogen projects and fuel-cell vehicle applications concentrate in four major industrial and demonstration clusters, with other projects distributed across the country.
hint: Select a region below or on the map
mapAlt: Map of China's provinces showing four hydrogen deployment clusters and other regions

overviewPanel.label: Overview
overviewPanel.title: Four main clusters + other regions
overviewPanel.body: Activity groups around the Greater Bay Area, Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta and Chengdu–Chongqing. Other projects are spread across industrial and demonstration sites elsewhere.
overviewPanel.note: Groupings are for presentation purposes; they are not an official classification or a complete list of projects.

gba.name: Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area
gba.area: Guangdong Province · Greater Bay Area cities
gba.body: Guangdong is a major hydrogen industry center. Foshan is a prominent hub for refueling infrastructure and multiple vehicle demonstrations, while Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Dongguan support industrial and port-oriented hydrogen logistics development.
gba.statLabel: hydrogen refueling stations across Guangdong Province
gba.statNote: Province-wide figure from the briefing material · reporting date not stated
gba.imageAlt: Gaoming hydrogen tram in Foshan, Guangdong, photographed by Nanfang Plus
gba.imageCredit: Photo: Nanfang Plus / 南方+ · Foshan Gaoming hydrogen tram

jjj.name: Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei Hydrogen Cluster
jjj.body: The Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei region has a hydrogen demonstration foundation, including winter-sports-related deployment. Zhangjiakou, Tangshan, and Handan are associated with industrial and heavy transport applications, while Beijing has emphasized public transport and municipal service vehicles.
jjj.imageAlt: Illustrative hydrogen tractor-trailer carrying steel coils in an industrial yard

yrd.name: Yangtze River Delta
yrd.body: Shanghai emphasizes port logistics and passenger fuel-cell vehicle demonstrations, while Jiaxing and Ningbo have urban logistics applications. Qingdao and Zibo in Shandong are related hydrogen industrial locations but lie outside the Yangtze River Delta region.
yrd.imageAlt: Illustrative hydrogen heavy-duty truck in a container port

cc.name: Chengdu–Chongqing Hydrogen Corridor
cc.body: The Chengdu–Chongqing region is developing hydrogen bus and intercity temperature-controlled freight applications, focusing on western China's transport and logistics needs.

other.name: Other Industrial and Demonstration Regions
other.area: Inner Mongolia · Shanxi · selected northeastern and southwestern locations
other.body: Inner Mongolia and Shanxi feature heavy-duty industrial and mining transport applications. Selected northeastern and southwestern locations have distributed demonstration projects, with uneven refueling infrastructure availability.
other.imageAlt: Illustrative hydrogen mining haul truck in an open-pit mine
